title: IQAC | Internal Quality Assurance Cell | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Internal Quality Assurance Cell Message from Director "Greetings from the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU). The IQAC has been established with the vision to build and sustain an environment for holistic growth of academic excellence, quality research, innovation activity, and systematic review of study programs. The cell is committed to promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement in teaching, learning, research, governance, and support systems." Prof. (Dr.) Ajay K Saluja Director, IQAC INSTITUTIONAL QUALITY About the Cell ESTABLISHMENT In alignment with NAAC requirements, IQAC at KPGU was established as a structured mechanism for quality sustenance and enhancement across academic and administrative areas. PURPOSE The cell channels institutional efforts toward holistic academic growth by identifying gaps, promoting quality culture, and formalizing best practices. CORE FOCUS Objectives & Strategies Objectives Objective 01 Develop a system for conscious, consistent, and catalytic action to improve the academic and administrative performance of the university. Objective 02 Promote measures for institutional functioning towards quality enhancement through the internalization of quality culture and the institutionalization of best practices. Strategies Ensuring timely, efficient, and progressive performance of academic, administrative, and financial tasks. Maintaining the relevance and quality of academic and research programs. Providing equitable access to academic programs for various sections of society. Optimizing and integrating modern teaching and learning methods. Ensuring the credibility of evaluation procedures. Adequately maintaining and allocating support structures and services. Sharing research findings and networking with other institutions in India and abroad. QUALITY ACTIVITY Functions & Responsibilities Key Functions Develop and apply quality benchmarks and parameters for academic and administrative activities. Facilitate a learner-centric environment conducive to quality education and faculty development. Arrange feedback from students, parents, and stakeholders on quality-related institutional processes. Disseminate information on quality parameters in higher education. Organize inter- and intra-institutional workshops and seminars on quality-related themes and promote quality circles. Document institutional programs and activities leading to quality improvement. Act as a nodal agency for coordinating quality-related activities, including adoption and dissemination of best practices. Develop and maintain an institutional database for quality enhancement. Prepare the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) as per NAAC guidelines. Member Responsibilities Members of the IQAC must generate and promote awareness in the institution and devote time to procedural details. The coordinator should be changed every two to three years to encourage fresh initiatives and renewed quality activity. Selection should consider senior administrators, departmental representation, and committed management representatives. Representatives from local society should have strong social standing and meaningful contribution to education. Professor, Krishna School of Emerging Technology and Applied Research ACCREDITATION Revised Framework & AQAR The NAAC Revised Accreditation Framework introduced a more structured AQAR process and strengthened the role of ICT in institutional assessment and accreditation. AQAR submission is part of the post-accreditation process, with annual timelines tied to the date of accreditation and supported through the NAAC portal. A functional IQAC and timely AQAR submission remain minimum requirements for later accreditation cycles, and peer teams assess progress through their interaction with the cell and its records. MANDATORY SUBMISSION Compliance Points The Executive Committee of NAAC mandated regular AQAR submission for the second and subsequent cycles of accreditation from 16 September 2016. A functional Internal Quality Assurance Cell is required for continued quality assurance activity. Minutes of IQAC meetings and compliance reports should be uploaded on the university website. AQARs must be submitted regularly for institutions undergoing second and later cycles of NAAC assessment. AQARs should remain accessible to stakeholders through the university website. Drs.
